newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Jan-Apr '97 trade gap wides to $534 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Jan-Apr '97 trade gap wides to $534 mln.

text.p: Sri Lanka's trade balance in the first four months of 1997 widened by 8.3 percent to $534 million from $493 million in the same period last year, the Central Bank said on Thursday.
Exports rose 13.6 percent to $1.359 billion during January-April this year from $1.197 billion in the same period last year, it said in a statement.
Imports were up 12 percent to $1.893 billion from $1.690 billion over the same period, the statement said.

Industrial exports were up 15.9 percent to $1.0 billion from $867 million, pushed up by a 18.5 percent rise in exports of textiles and apparels, which account for 65 percent of industrial exports, the statement added.
